checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three scenes in order, ~3s each: Earth, Jupiter, Saturn
must.why: Only Earth and Jupiter clips were provided. Both run about 3 s. The Saturn scene was not shown.

must.item: Each scene shows its exact date caption with 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible throughout
must.why: Earth scene: the caption and source lines are illegible garbled smudges. Jupiter scene: 'Voyager 1' is garbled and 'Source: NASA Science' is distorted. Only 'Jupiter flyby: 1979' is readable.

must.item: Probe has Voyager's dish and instrument booms, not solar panels
must.why: Both scenes show a white dish, a decagonal bus and long booms. The Earth-scene probe is a bit cluttered and the design differs between scenes, but it is recognisably Voyager.

must.item: Jupiter banded and Saturn with prominent rings, no Uranus/Neptune
must.why: Jupiter is clearly banded with the Great Red Spot. Saturn was not provided.

must.item: No Uranus/Neptune claims and no conflicting dates
must.why: No such claims appear in the frames shown. The Earth caption is illegible.
Audio cannot be judged from still frames. The assistant said the clip is silent.

exact_text.read_as: Earth scene: 'Voyager 1' is legible. Jupiter scene: 'Vunjøger 1', garbled.
Illegible smudge in the Earth scene, not readable as the date.
Jupiter scene: 'Source: NASA Scienčé', distorted. Earth scene: illegible.

faults.what: Earth scene: the launch date and source lines are garbled, unreadable text.
Jupiter scene: 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' have corrupted letters.
Captions are small and sit in the bottom-right corner. They are not a clean overlay.
The Saturn scene was not among the frames supplied, so it could not be verified.
The probe in the Earth scene looks cluttered. It differs in design from the Jupiter-scene probe.
Motion is only a slow drift.

summary: The Earth and Jupiter scenes show a convincing Voyager probe, but the required on-screen text is garbled in both scenes, including the launch date and the source line. The Saturn scene was not provided.
